podcast.body: Poly Styrene sang "O Bondage Up Yours!" for X-Ray Spex in 1978. The song, along with her unconventional image, was certainly not typical and served as an inspiration to many who saw her perform. "There's Paulie Styrin from 1978 singing for X-Ray Specks with O Bondage Up Yours."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: This song was performed by Paulie Styrin with her band X-Ray Spex in 1978, showcasing her unique punk style and confrontational lyrics. "There's Paulie Styrin from 1978 singing for X-Ray Specks with O Bondage Up Yours."
